_about: Ethanol (1) + n-Nonane (2): isothermal total pressures at 333.21 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of ethanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: C. Narasigadu, K. Moodley, J. D. Raal, Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Measurements of Ethanol and n-Nonane or n-Decane Binary Mixtures with Large Relative Volatility, J. Chem. Eng. Data 63 (2018) 1240-1248
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
